idea.title: Sunday, a calmer way to meal plan
idea.description: A meal-planning app that suggests a weekly menu from your preferences, builds a grocery list, and reminds you to cook. Users create an account, enter dietary preferences and follow a visual weekly calendar.
idea.audience: Busy individuals and households who want to spend less time planning meals.
idea.pricing: ₹299 per month after a seven-day trial.
